set_aside.subject: restriction on reading unwritten values
set_aside.text: “No module below `runs` reads a value that is not written” contradicts `run_values.assemble_mapped_lists` building and measuring a list “without writing”, and the existing duties of `sandbox`/`sandbox_runner` and `service_invoker` to inspect newly returned function or service values before their owning module writes them.
set_aside.question: Does this prohibition apply only to values being delivered as inputs to nodes, or literally to every value handled by every module below `runs`?
options: Apply it universally and reassign production/validation responsibilities
Name explicit exceptions for derived lists, sandbox results and service responses
set_aside.default_guess: Limit it to values being delivered as node inputs.
